summary: World of Tanks entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: World of Tanks

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC client at current high settings

primary.version: Current Windows client via Wargaming Game Center or Steam
primary.why: World of Tanks originated on Windows PC and remains a live online armored-combat service. The PC client has the strongest settings, input, and capture route; console Modern Armor and Blitz are related variants/spin-offs rather than required secondary content for the base PC entry.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows PC client through Wargaming Game Center or Steam, set graphics for the capture target, and record region, client version, and event/update state.

entries.remaster_caveats: World of Tanks Blitz and World of Tanks Modern Armor are related variants and should not be treated as the definitive version of the base PC service. Record live update/version state.
